desc_en: This piece redefines contemporary tailoring with a bold and sophisticated design. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, it features a regular fit silhouette and a flat lapel collar that provides structure and distinction. The graphic pattern brings a unique character to any refined wardrobe. Designed to offer versatility across formal occasions and special events, this blazer integrates seamlessly into modern ensembles. Each garment is made to order to ensure absolute exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.

Su patrón gráfico aporta un carácter único a cualquier guardarropa refinado. Diseñado para ofrecer versatilidad en ocasiones formales y eventos especiales, este blazer se integra con elegancia en conjuntos modernos. Cada prenda se elabora bajo demanda para garantizar una exclusividad absoluta. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
